skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of accounting information systems, roles of accountants, development cycle, characteristics in digital economy.
Apply procedures for organizing accounting vouchers, accounts, ledgers, and reports.
Apply database principles and organization in business context.
Explain the significance of describing accounting information systems using various tools.
Sketch accounting information systems using various tools to describe data flow, information, voucher circulation for analysis, evaluation, and improvement.
Develop basic computer skills in using Microsoft Office products for organizing, designing, and presenting accounting information systems.
Develop critical thinking skills in applying accounting methods and policies.
Develop systematic thinking skills in identifying, classifying, measuring, recording accounting transactions and preparing financial statements.
Organize planning, coordination, management of resources, evaluation, and improvement of activities.
